clarity.notes: Result page separates overall status, score breakdown, AI overview, and per-question review without mixing actions from the interview room.

hierarchy.notes: Overall score and scoring status lead the page; detailed transcript/audio/keywords are contained in lower-priority question cards.

typography.notes: Uses the existing Be Vietnam Pro app typography with tabular numerics for score and progress values.

motion.notes: Uses restrained loading spinners, transitions, and auto-refresh during SCORING without adding decorative animation.

brand.notes: Keeps the dark Phong van IT surface system, canonical token classes, restrained accent use, and clear success/danger states.
